title: Tour Block
description: A block that renders the tour

data.title: Data
data.description: Data object for the Tour block

accentColor.title: Accent Color
accentColor.description: The accent color for the tour points

narrativePanelPosition.title: Narrative Panel Position
narrativePanelPosition.description: The position of the narrative panel

narrativePanelSize.title: Narrative Panel Size
narrativePanelSize.description: The size of the narrative panel

map.title: Map id
map.description: The id of the map associated with the tour

places.title: Places data
places.description: An array of places in the tour

isNumberDescending.title: Is Number Descending
isNumberDescending.description: Whether the numbering of tour points is descending

startingNumber.title: Starting Number
startingNumber.description: The starting number for the tour points

categories.title: Categories data
categories.description: An array of categories in the tour

title.title: Block Title
title.description: The display title for the tour

hideThumbnail.title: Hide Thumbnail
hideThumbnail.description: Whether to hide the thumbnail images for tour places

description.title: Block Description
description.description: The display description for the tour

dataSource.title: Data Source ID
dataSource.description: The resource ID for a data source (currently only feature-service-backed ArcGIS Feature Layer/Feature View item)

placesLayerIdentifiers.title: Places Layer Identifiers
placesLayerIdentifiers.description: Id of the place data resides in the layer (data-driven only, for layers with sublayers)

titleFieldName.title: Title Field Name
titleFieldName.description: The field name to use for the title (data-driven only)

descriptionFieldName.title: Description Field Name
descriptionFieldName.description: The field name to use for the description (data-driven only)

attributionFieldName.title: Attribution Field Name
attributionFieldName.description: The field name to use for the attribution of an image (data-driven only)

altTextFieldName.title: Alt Text Field Name
altTextFieldName.description: The field name to use for the alt text of an image (data-driven only)

imgUrlFieldName.title: Image URL Field Name
imgUrlFieldName.description: The field name to use for image urls (data-driven only). If undefined, default is to use feature attachments

thumbnailUrlFieldName.title: Thumbnail URL Field Name
thumbnailUrlFieldName.description: The field name to use for a thumbnail image url. In the UI, the thumbnail image will be generated from the imgUrlFieldname if there is one. If both properties are undefined, default is to use a feature attachment.

categoryFieldName.title: Category Field Name
categoryFieldName.description: The field name to use for categories (data-driven only, categorized only)

sortFieldName.title: Sort Field Name
sortFieldName.description: The field name used for sorting the places (data-driven only)

sortDirection.title: Sort Direction
sortDirection.description: The direction for sorting the places (data-driven only)

maximumPlaceCount.title: Maximum Place Count
maximumPlaceCount.description: The maximum number of places to include in the tour (data-driven only)

maximumMediaPerPlace.title: Maximum Media Per Place
maximumMediaPerPlace.description: The maximum number of media items to include per place (data-driven only)

mediaPlacement.title: Media Placement
mediaPlacement.description: Placement of the media within the tour place

fill.title: Fill
fill.description: Fill properties for the image block

x.title: X Position
x.description: The horizontal focal point of the image when the placement type is 'fill'

y.title: Y Position
y.description: The vertical focal point of the image when the placement type is 'fill'

fit.title: Fit
fit.description: Fit properties for the image block

color.title: Background Color
color.description: A hex value for the color, or a known theme color value (e.g. backgroundColor)

backgroundType.title: Background Type
backgroundType.description: Type of background to display behind media

showPlacesWithoutMedia.title: Show Places Without Media
showPlacesWithoutMedia.description: Whether to show places that do not have media (data-driven only)

supportedMediaTypes.title: Supported Media Types
supportedMediaTypes.description: The media types that are supported (data-driven only)

buttons.title: Configurable Buttons
buttons.description: A configurable button associated with each place. Only up to 2 buttons are allowed.

buttonText.title: Button Text
buttonText.description: The text to display within the Button block

buttonLinkFieldName.title: Button Link Field Name
buttonLinkFieldName.description: The field name of the Button block link

showLeastRecentAttachmentFirst.title: Show Least Recent Attachment First
showLeastRecentAttachmentFirst.description: Whether to show the least recent attachment first (data-driven only)

isOriginalCategorizedSortOrder.title: Is Original Categorized Sort Order
isOriginalCategorizedSortOrder.description: Whether to use the original sort order for categorized tours

featureId.description: The ID of the corresponding feature, if exists

media.description: The blockID of the place media

title.description: The blockID of the place title

contents.description: The block IDs of additional content

isHidden.title: Is Hidden
isHidden.description: Whether the place block is hidden

alias.description: Data driven only, for over-riding category name from feature service

color.description: Color of category icon; used for map pins of category features, as well in list of categories on categorized tour overview

icon.description: Icon for category; used for map pins of category features, as well in list of categories on categorized tour overview
